title: Page 5
content_zh:
这日在散朝后，路翔瘫坐在龙椅内疲惫地闭着眼，俞想俞是觉得心酸，俞想俞是有种想拿鞋拍死那只挑剔龟，然后去找斐然说他要退货换货的神动……

怎么别人的魂役就是卖力又卖命，为了魂主，至死也无怨无悔无惧无畏，哪怕是上刀山下火海，只消魂主一个命令就义无反顾的往前冲，忠心耿耿地视魂主为天上地下的唯一！而他家的魂役却是成天挂着邪恶的冷笑，老威胁要去投胎不说，还处心积虑的想拉着他这魂主去当垫背？

那张魂纸绝对是张不良品。

抬指按着阵阵刺痛的两际，路翔是怎么也提不起脚回宫去，他一点也不想再去面对那只完全不照规矩来的魂役。

在宫内没找着他，特意来到朝殿上的路露，在见着了已有半月不见的自家亲弟后，忍不住掩嘴惊呼。

“皇弟，你怎变得那么憔悴……”

能不憔悴吗？换她来日日伺候那只龟毛龟试试。

尤其那只龟还看他特不顺眼，动不动就想杀桌他好结束契约去投胎。

路露颇同情地看向他眼眶底下浓重的青影，和他眉眼间散不去的疲惫，然后她清清嗓子。

“那个，我帮仙师找到保镖了，是黄金门的门人……”这阵子她出宫去忙的，就是这桩对路国来说最重要的大事。

一听到黄金门这三字，路翔便俞想俞觉得不值，委屈得两眼直含泪。

“朕为什么要护着那只一天到晚都想弑君的无良龟，还给他找个贵得要死的保镖来看住他的龟命一条？没天理啊没天理……”

黄金门的门人是寻常人能请得起得吗？他们贵！虽说他们每个皆武艺高强贵得物超所值，所派出去的每一个门人，也从不砸黄金门的金字招牌，可路国穷得苦哈哈呀！继花光了皇姊的嫁妆买魂纸后，为请保镖，这下非得搬空他大半国库不可了。

路露搔着发，“这不是没办法吗？许都许出来了。”

闻言的路翔只是低头看着自个儿当初造孽签下血契的右手，冷不防地冒出一句。

“……能剁手指吗？”

“皇上请千万保重龙体！”守在殿上贴身保护皇帝的赤水，急急冲上前按住他的右手，要他打消这歪主意。

路翔两眼无神地间：“那今晚炖锅龟汤给朕补补身子如何？”倘若那只仙龟下凡的目的就只是想折腾他，那他还不如就当作从没许过愿，也没有这么个让人忍不住想掐死的魂役。

“呃，这个……”赤水明显被噎了一下。

“行了，别撒娇了。”路露拍拍两掌，一点也没跟他客气，“听着，既然都已把仙师许出来了，那咱们可不能让他随便死了，因此就算黄金门的保镖费再贵，这钱咱们无论如何都得花，不然仙师若是不小心死于非命，咱们只会更亏本。”

皇弟跟仙师大人不对盘，这点明眼人都知道，可即使这样，路露也不会纵着自家皇弟对仙师大人摆架子甩脾气，当然更不会瞧不起那只看似懒散挑剔，但却很有可能其实是深藏不露的魂役。

眼下最重要的是，他们家的仙师大人，不通半点凡间的武艺。

这不，仙师大人才进宫受封没几日，宫外那些以为他是来抢地盘的各大宗教，就连连派人来暗杀了好几回。而每一回他们也不见仙师大人大显什么神通，他其至连躲都懒得躲，好似一点也不在乎他这条龟命，无可奈何下，她只好命赤水扛着不躲也不闪，一心只想找死的仙师大人边逃边保命去。

只是赤水护得了他一日，能护得了他永远？

只要国内各大宗教领袖一日对仙师大人心存忌惮，仙师大人的性命就一日被搁在屠刀下，而她，可万万不能让他们路国的唯一浮木，就这么莫名其妙地被杀沉了。

因此在将来仙师大人出手实现皇弟的心愿，大力整顿好国内的各个宗教前，她不介意再出一回血本，再花一大笔银子去请人来给他当保镖。

而放眼当今世上，有什么高人是花花银两就能请得来的？

答案是黄金门。

那个要钱不要命的门派。

路翔盯着自家皇姊那副没得商量的表情，虽明知皇姊所说的都对，可他就是打心底很想拍扁那只对凡人带着浓浓敌意的龟毛龟。

“可以踹了那只挑东捡西还成天吃饱不干事的闲龟吗？”大不了再买张魂纸来许愿。

路露轻描淡写地瞥他一眼，“踹了就浪费了，且那张魂纸很贵。”国库里哪来的闲钱？

“朕究竟是造了什么孽……”路翔沮丧地两手抱着头，一想到还要跟那只龟继续相处下去，便满腔尽是浓得化不开的悲愤，“朕将他许出来，是想要他为朕分忧解劳、救路国于水火的，偏偏他就是看朕从头到脚没一处顺眼。你们说，这天上飞的、地上爬的、垃里埋的那么多，朕为何哪只都不许，偏偏就是倒霉的许到他？”

“……”赤水捣摸脑袋，无言地望着殿顶上的离花纹饰，而路露则是点点十指，低首专心看着大殿上光洁的地板。”

就在路翔犹自怜得没完投了的这当头，宫外远处隐约传来了一阵又一阵的喊打喊杀声，让不明所以的路翔重新抬起头来。

“外头这是？”路翔侧首看向神情一脸凝重的赤水。

“回皇上，巫教青黄两派近来就要举行祭巫大典，青派首领与黄派首领于日前达成共识，说是自皇上登基后本国就风不调雨不顺，再加之前阵子皇上您又降旨敕封仙师，所以……”

“所以什么？”

赤水老老实实地？完，“他们认为皇上遭小人所蒙蔽，于是他们打算清君恻，顺便拉仙师大人去祭巫以改国运。”

“请君侧？祭巫？”路翔大掌重重往桌案上一拍，觉得这简直冤他冤到极点了，“那只龟毛龟还什么都没有做呢，日后也不见得他大爷肯纡尊降贵去替朕做些什么，朕这皇帝都不急他们急些什么？”

路露一脸尴尬，“咳，皇弟……”这种事偷偷在心底想就好了，他也不必说出来吧。

烦得只想找面墙撞撞的路翔像泄了气般，提不起劲地坐回龙椅里，试着在内忧外患的这当头找出些许还残留着的理智。

“皇姊，保镖何时会到？”宫外的武林高手太多，即使羽林军阻拦得了那些以宗教为利剑的宗教暴民，却难以栏阻人了武道的剌客们，唯今之计，他们唯一可以指望的，就是黄金门的相级高手。

“就这两日。”

“赤水。”路翔一骨碌坐起，将腰杆梃得正直向他仔细地叮嘱，“将宫中所有的羽林军都调去仙师那儿，这两日内可千万替朕将他给看牢了，在黄金门派人来前，绝不能让他出任何事。”

赤水惶然地抬起头，“那皇上您怎么办？”宫中人手本就不足，若是把兵员全都拨到仙师那儿去了，那些宗教乱党若是闯进宫中伤了皇上，或是想趁机杀了皇上改朝换代该如何是好？

这是个好问题。

仙师大人若是一命归西，身为魂主的他虽不会有事，可他期盼改革的历望就将落空不说，他们为买魂纸而花的那笔大钱，也将跟着打水漂了。

而他若是不小心去见了列祖列宗，那么身为魂役的仙师大人则与他同死，当下就可一偿宿愿转身轮回去，因此在保住仙师之前，他还得先想法子保住他自个儿的性命。

路翔揉着眉心，不甘不愿地道：“朕陪仙师一块儿躲着，这两日就拜托你了……”
content_en:
After the court ended that day, Lu Xiang sat slumped in the dragon chair and closed his eyes tiredly. Yu Xiang Yu felt sad. Yu Xiang Yu felt like slapping the picky turtle to death with his shoe, and then went to Fei Ran to tell Shendong that he wanted to return the goods for exchange...

Why do other people's soul service mean working hard and working hard, for the soul master, even to death without any regrets, no fear, no fear, even if they have to go up the mountain of swords and into the sea of fire, they only need the soul master's order to rush forward without hesitation, and they loyally regard the soul master as the only one in heaven and earth!But his soul servant always had an evil sneer on his face, always threatening to reincarnate, and deliberately trying to use him as the soul master as a backer?

That piece of soul paper is definitely a defective piece.

Lifting his fingers to press the stinging joints, Lu Xiang couldn't lift his feet to go back to the palace. He didn't want to face the soul slave who didn't follow the rules at all.

Lu Lu, who didn't find him in the palace and came to the court hall specially, couldn't help covering her mouth and exclaimed after seeing her own brother who hadn't been seen for half a month.

"Royal brother, why have you become so haggard..."

Can you not feel haggard?Let her try to serve that turtle every day.

In particular, the turtle didn't like him very much, and always wanted to kill him so that he could end the contract and reincarnate.

Lu Lu looked sympathetically at the thick blue shadows under his eyes and the lingering fatigue in his brows, and then she cleared her throat.

"Well, I helped the immortal master find a bodyguard. He is a disciple of the Golden Gate..." What she was leaving the palace to do at this time was the most important event for Lu Guo.

As soon as he heard the words "Golden Gate", Lu Xiang felt that it was not worth it, and he felt so aggrieved that his eyes filled with tears.

"Why should I protect that unscrupulous turtle who wants to kill the king all day long, and also find him an extremely expensive bodyguard to protect his turtle's life? There is no justice in heaven..."

Can ordinary people afford to hire the disciples of the Golden Gate?They are expensive!Although each of them is highly skilled in martial arts and expensive and worth every penny, and every disciple they send out never smashes the golden signboard of the Golden Gate, Lu Country is so poor, haha!After spending all the royal sister's dowry to buy soul paper, in order to hire bodyguards, he had to empty most of his treasury.

Lulu scratched her hair, "Isn't there nothing we can do? Xu Duxu is out."

After hearing this, Lu Xiang just looked down at his right hand that had sinfully signed the blood contract and said something unexpectedly.

"...can I chop off my fingers?"

"Your Majesty, please take care of the dragon body!" Chishui, who was guarding the emperor in the palace, rushed forward and pressed his right hand, asking him to give up this crooked idea.

Lu Xiang's eyes were blank: "How about making a pot of turtle soup to replenish my body tonight?" If the purpose of that fairy turtle coming down to earth was just to torment him, then he might as well pretend that he had never made a wish, and there was no such thing as a soul slave that made people want to strangle him.

"Uh, this..." Chishui was obviously choked.

"Okay, stop being coquettish." Lu Lu clapped her hands and was not polite to him at all. "Listen, since the immortal master has been promised, we can't let him die casually. Therefore, no matter how expensive the bodyguard fee of the Golden Gate is, we have to spend the money no matter what. Otherwise, if the immortal master accidentally dies, we will only lose more money."

Everyone with a discerning eye knows that the emperor's younger brother and the Immortal Master are not at odds with each other, but even so, Lu Lu will not let her imperial brother show off and lose his temper with the Immortal Master. Of course, she will not look down on the one who seems lazy and picky, but is very likely to have a hidden spirit.

The most important thing right now is that their Immortal Master doesn't know any mortal martial arts.

No, just a few days after Master Immortal entered the palace and was granted the title, the major religions outside the palace thought he was here to seize territory and sent people to assassinate him several times.And every time, they didn't see Master Xian show any magical power. He didn't even bother to hide, as if he didn't care about his life at all. With no choice, she had no choice but to order Chishui to carry him without dodging or dodging. Master Xian, who only wanted to die, ran away to save his life.

It's just that Chishui can protect him for a day, but can it protect him forever?

As long as the major religious leaders in the country were afraid of the Immortal Master, the Immortal Master's life would be put at the mercy of the butcher's knife, and she would never let the only driftwood in their country be killed inexplicably.

Therefore, in the future, before the Master Immortal takes action to fulfill the emperor's brother's wish and vigorously rectify various religions in the country, she does not mind spending another round of money and spending a large sum of money to hire someone to be his bodyguard.

And looking at the world today, are there any experts who can be hired with just a few dollars?

The answer is the Golden Gate.

That sect that wants money rather than life.

Lu Xiang stared at his imperial sister's non-negotiable expression. Although he knew that what the imperial sister said was correct, from the bottom of his heart he just wanted to slap that turtle that was so hostile to mortals.

"Can you kick that idle turtle who picks things up and eats all day without doing anything?" At the worst, I can buy a piece of soul paper to make a wish.

Lu Lu glanced at him lightly, "It's a waste if you kick it, and the soul paper is very expensive." Where does the spare money come from in the treasury?

"What evil did I commit..." Lu Xiang held his head in his hands in frustration, and when he thought of continuing to get along with that turtle, he was filled with indescribable grief and anger, "I promised him out because I wanted him to share my worries.Lao, the one who saves the country from water and fire, but he just doesn't like me from head to toe.You think, there are so many flying in the sky, crawling on the ground, and buried in the garbage, why do I not allow any of them, but I am unlucky to allow him?"

"..." Chishui patted his head and looked at the Lihua pattern on the roof of the hall wordlessly, while Lu Lu nodded his fingers, lowered his head and looked at the smooth floor of the hall intently."

Just at this moment when Lu Xiang was still filled with self-pity, there were faint sounds of shouting and killing in the distance outside the palace, which made Lu Xiang, who was not sure what was going on, raise his head again.

"What's this outside?"Lu Xiang turned his head and looked at Chishui, who had a solemn look on his face.

"Back to the emperor, the green and yellow sects of the witchcraft religion will hold a witch sacrificial ceremony soon. The leaders of the green sect and the yellow sect have reached a consensus a few days ago, saying that the country has been in trouble since the emperor ascended the throne. In addition, the emperor issued a decree to confer immortal master a while ago, so..."

"So what?"

Chishui honestly?End, "They thought that the emperor was deceived by villains, so they planned to express his sympathy and invite the immortal master to sacrifice witches in order to change the fate of the country."

"Please come to your side?Witch sacrifice?"Lu Xiang slapped the table with his big palm, feeling that this was an extreme injustice to him, "That turtle has not done anything yet, and there is no chance that his uncle will be willing to condescend to do something for me in the future. If I, the emperor, are not anxious, why should they be anxious?"

Lu Lu looked embarrassed, "Ahem, Emperor brother..." It's fine if he secretly thinks about this kind of thing in his heart, he doesn't need to say it out loud.

Lu Xiang, who was so annoyed that he just wanted to hit a wall, seemed to be discouraged. He sat back in the dragon chair with no energy, trying to find some remaining sanity in this time of internal and external troubles.

"Sister Royal, when will the bodyguards arrive?"There are too many martial arts masters outside the palace. Even if the Yulin Army can stop the religious mobs who use religion as their sword, they can't stop the martial arts assassins. The only way they can count on now is the prime minister masters of the Golden Gate.

“Just these two days."

“Chishui."Lu Xiang sat up suddenly, straightened his waist and told him carefully, "Transfer all the Yulin troops in the palace to the Immortal Master. He will be imprisoned for me in these two days. Before the Golden Sect sends people, nothing will happen to him."

Chishui raised his head in panic, "Then what should you do, Your Majesty?"The manpower in the palace is insufficient. If all the soldiers are transferred to the immortal master, what if those religious gangsters break into the palace and hurt the emperor, or want to take the opportunity to kill the emperor and change the dynasty?

This is a good question.

If the Immortal Master dies and dies, although he, as the soul master, will be fine, his hope for reform will be in vain, and the large sum of money they spent to buy the soul paper will also be wasted.

And if he accidentally meets his ancestors, then the immortal master who is a soul slave will die with him, and he can immediately fulfill his wish and turn around and reincarnate. Therefore, before saving the immortal master, he must first find a way to save his own life.

Lu Xiang rubbed his eyebrows and said reluctantly: "I will hide with the immortal master. I will leave it to you for the next two days..."
